annotations.title: Point a live lead ad at another Instant Form

description:
[writes · `ads:manage` scope] Points a live Meta lead ad (adId) at another Instant Form (newFormId) without Ads Manager: creates a new ad PAUSED in the same ad set with the same copy and media and the new form, switches it on, and only then pauses the old ad. Returns oldAdId and newAdId. A failed step stops there and says what serves. Single-image and single-video ads only. Pass idempotencyKey to make a retry safe, and agentName and reason. Audited in Ads > Agent activity. Confirm with the user first.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/ads/lead-forms/swap-ad.)

agentName.description: Which agent is acting. Shown to the owner in Ads > Agent activity.

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional; 1-255 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -. Makes a retry of the create safe.

name.description: Optional new ad name; default "<old name> (form <id>)".

newFormId.description: The Instant Form the new ad uses (digits).

reason.description: Why the agent is doing this. Shown to the owner and kept in the audit trail.

name: ads_lead_form_swap_ad
title: Point a live lead ad at another Instant Form
